name: Novolak (Novolaksky-Khasavyurt) Gas Branch Pipeline
researcher_notes: NEW ROW, medium. Not in roster: nearest rows P0751 (Hajigabul-Shirvanovka-Mozdok / Kazi Magomed-Mozdok trunk), P1477 (Kumli-Kizlyar-Babayurt-Aksai) are trunks, none is a Novolakskoye spur; the consolidator's 'branch off P0751' is NOT stated in any source read (tap point unidentified), so Start location is left blank and the P0751 link is unverified (plausible: Gazprom transgaz Makhachkala operates Mozdok-Kazimagomed). Threshold: (a) sponsor/operator Gazprom transgaz Makhachkala (CEO A. Astanin reported at the Dagestan government's Republican HQ for winter prep, June 2025); (b) country + region + end (Dagestan, Novolakskoye village; serves Novolaksky and Khasavyurt districts); (c) concrete step satisfied: new 325 mm, 29.3 km pipe built in 2024 on a NEW alignment replacing the 159 mm 1986 branch; mirmol.ru wording is 'введен в эксплуатацию' (commissioned) so Status=operating; (d) length 29.3 km sourced (>=25 km). All four news items repeat the single Gazprom transgaz Makhachkala press statement of 2025-06-26 (mk.ru Dagestan, zamana.info, mirmol.ru, yoldash.ru), so independent=false; Interfax-Russia carries it too but its page is behind a JS bot challenge (not cited, unverified). Federal territorial-planning scheme (Govt order 816-r, annex item 193, via sudact.ru, verified Novolak text) lists 'Реконструкция газопровода-отвода к сел. Новолак' serving Novolakskoye, Novomekheltinsky, Novochurtakh, Gamiyakh, Barchkhoyotar, Batashyurt, Solnechnoye, Osmanyurt, Adzhimazhagatyurt villages, design annual volume 0.305 million m3 (not entered as Capacity: unit/annual-volume ambiguity, equals ~0.0003 bcm/y; not a throughput rating). Cited only here as plan context, not as a [ref] for any value. This is a replacement build, so it is a new physical pipe (LengthKnown 29.3, Diameter 325, not the expansion-with-no-pipe case); the old 159 mm 1986 branch is a separate decommissioned/replaced line not captured. ConstructionYear 2024 per sources; StartYear1 2025 is an inference from the June 2025 completion/commissioning report (exact commissioning date not stated) - treat as approximate. PipelineType left blank (branch/spur vocabulary to be chosen by reviewer). Route: none found (no official GIS or published trace); RouteType Unavailable / RouteAccuracy no route; do not fabricate. Owner entity: entity_lookup finds no Gazprom transgaz Makhachkala in the gas tracker (closest 'Transgaz', 'Gazprom PJSC' 73 - different), so Owner is a new entity under Parent Gazprom PJSC (existing entity).
